entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why's all this shit happenin' inside[n]her own heart?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thieves showin' up, all those weird voices[n]sayin' "you killed her"... It's insane.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So does this mean that even though she's[n]the Palace ruler, she can't control what[n]happens in here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She may be losing sight of who she truly is[n]due to her repressed memories.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, for now we should head back and[n]open that gate of fire.
